## Summary

The available SCEX evidence shows **strongly positive promotion by this KOL**, centered on SCEX rewards, leaderboard participation, referrals, and expectations that the exchange would become available for trading. The KOL’s own posts state that they were a **Top 100 participant and prize recipient**, creating a direct incentive to maintain a favorable view. This is a credibility conflict, not proof that the claims were false. [2026-09-09 08:14 UTC](https://x.com/luong4101992/status/2097599410964488504)

The supplied record contains **20 SCEX-related posts from 2026-07-28 through 2026-09-18**. The highest-engagement posts promoted the reward campaign and leaderboard, with **1,995 views** and **968 views**, respectively. [2026-08-18 10:38 UTC](https://x.com/luong4101992/status/2089663121686507785) [2026-08-19 08:51 UTC](https://x.com/luong4101992/status/2089998553330626683)

## Credibility signals

- The KOL record reports **32,323 followers**, **36 posts**, a **quality score of 74.7**, and a **volume score of 100**; the record was current as of **2026-09-20** and updated on **2026-09-22 03:44 UTC**. These are supplied platform metrics, not independently verified evidence of accuracy. [2026-09-20](https://x.com/luong4101992)
- The KOL disclosed direct campaign involvement: they said they were bullish early, ranked in the **Top 100**, and had won a prize. [2026-09-09 08:14 UTC](https://x.com/luong4101992/status/2097599410964488504)
- The KOL also stated that they had completed requested information procedures after receiving an email, indicating a personal stake in the reward process. [2026-09-09 08:14 UTC](https://x.com/luong4101992/status/2097599410964488504)
- Engagement was concentrated in promotional posts rather than neutral analysis. The largest supplied post received **1,995 views, 25 likes, 27 replies, and 2 reposts**. [2026-08-18 10:38 UTC](https://x.com/luong4101992/status/2089663121686507785)
- **Insufficient evidence** to independently verify the KOL’s identity, expertise, compensation arrangements, or historical accuracy.

## Exchange stance

The KOL’s stance was **consistently favorable**, including:

- Describing SCEX as a highly active project and encouraging others to participate. [2026-09-18 09:45 UTC](https://x.com/luong4101992/status/2100883914013528099)
- Thanking SCEX and calling it a Vietnamese exchange with extensive preparation. [2026-09-18 04:34 UTC](https://x.com/luong4101992/status/2100805644232302754)
- Saying they remained bullish while asking followers to wait for rewards. [2026-09-09 08:14 UTC](https://x.com/luong4101992/status/2097599410964488504)
- Saying SCEX should complete procedures so users could trade on a Vietnamese exchange. [2026-09-09 08:14 UTC](https://x.com/luong4101992/status/2097599410964488504)

There was some acknowledgment of operational delay and criticism of the reward process. The KOL said reward processing was taking longer than expected and suggested that the campaign’s approval procedures should have been completed before the event. [2026-09-09 08:14 UTC](https://x.com/luong4101992/status/2097599410964488504)

The record does **not** establish whether SCEX actually completed reward payments to all eligible participants, whether it holds required regulatory permissions, or whether it became fully operational. **Insufficient evidence.**

## Tokens promoted

No specific token ticker or named token is promoted in the supplied SCEX posts. The promotion concerns:

- **SCEX as an exchange/project**
- **SCEX reward and airdrop participation**
- **Referral activity**
- **Leaderboard prizes**
- **Future trading access on the exchange**

**Insufficient evidence** of promotion of any separate token, coin, contract address, or token sale.

## Red flags

- **Direct financial incentive:** The KOL stated that they were a prize recipient and were waiting for their own reward. This materially weakens the independence of their bullish commentary. [2026-09-09 08:14 UTC](https://x.com/luong4101992/status/2097599410964488504)
- **Reward-delay risk:** The posts describe rewards as delayed, with references to a two-week processing period and uncertainty about when funds would arrive. [2026-09-09 04:17 UTC](https://x.com/luong4101992/status/2097539761766560202) [2026-09-09 08:14 UTC](https://x.com/luong4101992/status/2097599410964488504)
- **Referral incentives:** The KOL referenced obtaining additional active referrals and encouraged participation, which can amplify promotional bias. [2026-09-18 04:57 UTC](https://x.com/luong4101992/status/2100811414076326131)
- **Unverified reward claims:** The KOL repeated prize amounts and tax-processing details, but the supplied evidence does not independently confirm the campaign terms or payments. [2026-08-18 10:38 UTC](https://x.com/luong4101992/status/2089663121686507785) [2026-08-19 08:51 UTC](https://x.com/luong4101992/status/2089998553330626683)
- **Low per-post reach relative to follower count:** The supplied posts generally show limited views, with the highest listed at 1,995 against a reported 32,323 followers. This may indicate uneven distribution or limited audience activity, but the dataset is insufficient to draw a firm conclusion. [2026-08-18 10:38 UTC](https://x.com/luong4101992/status/2089663121686507785)
- **Informal promotional language:** Repeated encouragement to “take” or “farm” the opportunity suggests campaign-style promotion rather than independent due diligence. [2026-08-19 08:51 UTC](https://x.com/luong4101992/status/2089998553330626683)

## Amplifier network

The supplied mentions show the KOL interacting with multiple accounts around SCEX, including:

`@vuntqn91`, `@EnergyVN_`, `@vtn1508`, `@cuonggiau2`, `@Evans_9999`, `@GhostxWriterx`, `@Kenz_1604`, `@tazmancrypto`, `@vinhdtrai`, `@GigaYap`, `@DungMagicSquare`, `@QWarm1990`, `@Cryptoislife99`, and `@vickys_yui`.

The network appears to function primarily as a **reply-based engagement and referral-amplification cluster**: many posts are direct replies containing short endorsements, reward updates, or encouragement to participate. Examples include replies about SCEX activity, reward timing, referrals, and campaign sentiment. [2026-09-18 09:45 UTC](https://x.com/luong4101992/status/2100883914013528099) [2026-09-18 04:57 UTC](https://x.com/luong4101992/status/2100811414076326131) [2026-09-09 08:16 UTC](https://x.com/luong4101992/status/2097600007155470589)

The data does not prove coordinated activity, paid amplification, bot usage, or undisclosed sponsorship. **Insufficient evidence.**
